Contract:
Proposed by the read-only audit worker, then appended by the execute orchestrator's bounded administrative ticket channel as a `## Audit Rounds` section (created on first reopen-triggering audit; subsequent audits append `### Audit Round N` entries). Same compact AI-to-AI inline grammar as `AUDIT_SESSION_SUMMARY_FORMAT` — the ticket carries the canonical audit record machines can re-parse later. Shape inside the ticket: ```markdown ## Audit Rounds ### Audit Round — , after Execution Round ``` @audit task= round= mode=per-task after-exec-round= triggered-reopen= status= counts=B·M·m·I phases_to_fix=[

,...] F-NN | sev=… | type=… | conf=… | loc=… | phase=… | src=… | route=… | act=… … @glossary suggestions=[] ``` ``` Concrete example (inside a ticket file): ```markdown ## Audit Rounds ### Audit Round 1 — 2026-05-12, after Execution Round 1 ``` @audit task=TSK-04 round=1 mode=per-task after-exec-round=1 triggered-reopen=Round-2 status=FAIL counts=B1·M1·m0·I0 phases_to_fix=[P2] F-01 | sev=B | type=CLOSED_WORLD_DRIFT | conf=H | loc=src/payments/adapter.ts:42 | phase=P2 | src=specs/backend/payments/payments.spec.md#2 | route=spec-edit | act=добавить `IdempotencyKey` в Entity Inventory F-02 | sev=M | type=RULES_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION | conf=H | loc=src/payments/adapter.ts:100 | phase=P2 | src=ai/directives/coding/typescript-rules.xml#AX_STRICT_NULL | route=ticket-reopen | act=добавить null-guard на response.balanceTransaction @glossary suggestions=[] ``` ``` Constraints: - Append-only. Prior `### Audit Round` entries are immutable (mirrors Round-immutability in `phase-execution-protocol`). - PASS audits without reopen are NOT written here — output stays ephemeral. - `N` increments monotonically across the ticket's lifetime, independent of Execution Round numbers. - The fenced code block inside each round is the same compact grammar as `AUDIT_SESSION_SUMMARY_FORMAT` — machines parse it without rewriting.
